curation.notes: Electro-osmotic capture and directional co-translocational unfolding of thioredoxin (Trx-linker) polyproteins (dimer to nonamer, >1,200 residues) through an engineered charge-selective (NN-113R)7 nanopore in a planar lipid bilayer, read out by ionic current; nonamers carry single phosphorylation, glutathionylation or glycosylation sites. No beads or external force transducer are used.

evidence.snippet: Ionic currents were measured at 24 ± 1 °C by using Ag/AgCl electrodes connected to the headstage of an Axopatch 200B amplifier.
Signals were low-pass filtered at 10 kHz and sampled at 50 kHz with a Digidata 1440A digitizer (Molecular Devices).

N-terminal cysteine-glycine codons were included to give the final concatemer constructs: His6-SUMO-CysGly-(Trx-linker)n (n = 2, 4, 6) and His6-SUMO-CysGly-(Trx-linker)7Trx.

entities.name: Trx-linker nonamer with central RRASAC site (phosphorylated, glutathionylated or glycosylated)

evidence.snippet: subsequently cloned in between the KpnI and AvrII sites within the Trx-linker octamer to give (Trx-linker)4-Trx-linker(RRASAC)-(Trx-linker)4.
After a single (NN-113R)7 pore had inserted into the bilayer, the solution was replaced with a fresh buffer by manual pipetting, to prevent further insertions.

solution.notes: Recording buffers: 750 mM GdnHCl, 1.5 M GdnHCl, 3.0 M GdnHCl, 2.0 M urea/750 mM KCl or 750 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 5 mM TCEP pH 7.2 (dimer-octamer); 375 mM GdnHCl/375 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.2 (nonamers). Lipid: DPhPC bilayer.
